string-array.name: import_1password_steps
string-array.item: In 1Password on a computer, open File, then Export, and choose the account to export.
Choose the 1PUX format, or CSV, and save the file. 1Password can\'t protect either with a password, so keep it somewhere private.
Choose the file here. Items that have a one-time password are brought across.

resources.string: Delete the export once the import is done: it holds every password in the account in the clear.
